Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong AWS/Azure expertise to support infrastructure setup and cloud migrations, leveraging GitLab (DXOne) and related tooling to drive efficient and scalable deployments.
 Responsibilities
Set up and configure AWS/Azure infrastructure to support cloud migrations
Create and configure virtual machines according to best practices
Build and maintain application CI/CD pipelines
Develop infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
Write automation scripts to streamline operational tasks
Manage and maintain GitLab (DXOne) for build and deployment processes
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth migration execution
 Requirements
5+ years of experience in DevOps engineering with a focus on AWS/Azure infrastructure
Skills in VM creation and configuration following best practices
Expertise in application CI/CD and GitLab (DXOne)
Proficiency in Terraform or CloudFormation for infrastructure as code
Competency in automation scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 Nice to have
Knowledge of Kubernetes
Familiarity with Terragrunt
Background in monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, ELK, or Sumo Logic
Understanding of other key AWS/Azure services
 We offer
Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
